Elena R: quick proposal to standardize pin fields: `scope` (tenant|global), `soft_expiry_s`, `hard_expiry_ts`, `rollback_target` (opaque), `pin_note` (opt, <=256). keep compact so clients can copy.

Sam W: +1. define semantics: when `soft_expiry_s` passes mark pin as stale but continue serving until `hard_expiry_ts`. runtime should add `pin_state` = active|stale|evicted.

Theo K: conflict resolution: prefer explicit override (RBAC) > scope priority (tenant > global) > intent priority if present > last-write. record `conflict_resolved_by` in audit.

Elena R: storage: add composite index (tenant, model, effective_hard_expiry) and a TTL index for soft expiries. runtime keeps a small heap of nearest expiries to drive eviction sweeps.

ops-bot: impact estimate: ~40 bytes/pin, ~500k active pins => ~20MB. background backfill ~5M writes; recommend spread over 48h.

Sam W: telemetry: emit `pin.set`, `pin.update`, `pin.mark_stale`, `pin.evict`, `pin.conflict` with labels owner, scope, outcome. alert on >3x baseline `pin.conflict`.

Theo K: API example:
PATCH /v1/pins/{id}
{
  "scope": "tenant",
  "soft_expiry_s": 3600,
  "hard_expiry_ts": "2026-04-05T12:00:00Z",
  "rollback_target": "variant:search-v2",
  "pin_note": "canary 5% for checkout flow"
}

Elena R: migration plan: 1) add nullable fields, 2) deploy control-plane to accept fields, 3) staggered backfill, 4) feature-flag conflict policy then flip after 2 weeks. I'll own schema+runbook; Sam owns telemetry; Theo owns runtime+indexes.

Sam W: will add dashboards and parsing rules.

Theo K: will put up a small runtime PR for stale marking and eviction heap.

Elena R: thanks everyone, posting PR link when ready. :rocket:
